# Shanaya Mahendran — Personal Web Portfolio

> Shanaya Mahendran is a Full-Stack Developer, Tech Enthusiast, and Open-Source Contributor. She builds modern, high-performance web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python (FastAPI), Prisma ORM, Supabase, and PostgreSQL.

- **Featured Projects**:

  - Smart Travel · Earth: The Oracle Challenge (Cre8X 3.0) submission by Legacy Aurora. UI/UX Designer; a sustainable multimodal mobility concept for Sri Lanka 2100; not selected to advance.
  - PathfinderAI: InnovaX 1.0 proposal submitted by Legacy Aurora. Candidate-centered agentic recruitment and skill verification; AI scorecards are advisory and final hiring decisions stay with people.
  - SDG Sprints 2026 Stage 02: Four Legacy Aurora proposals—CivicLens (civic service reporting), DigiEdu (offline-first digital literacy), EcoChain Lanka (QR-verified recycling network), and SkillLink Lanka (verified informal-worker marketplace). All are proposals in progress, not completed deployments.
  - The Passion Discovery Engine: Top 16 finalist at IntelliCon '26 Buildathon (HungryBeast). Full-Stack Developer on a student career-discovery platform.
  - Waypoint Dispatch Intelligence: Tech-Triathlon 2026 Designathon submission by team Legacy Aurora. Team Lead and Full-Stack Developer; not selected to advance.
  - Smart School Management System (SSMS): Enterprise-grade multi-role school management system (Admin, Teacher, Student, Parent) built with Next.js 14, Prisma, Supabase PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, and client-side PDF document generation.
  - Sara: Full-stack e-commerce platform built with FastAPI + PostgreSQL, Docker, FAISS vector search, WebSockets, and Vite frontend.
  - CabXpert: Vehicle reservation system using Java EE (Jersey JAX-RS), MySQL, JDBC, and Bootstrap.
  - Elegant Notes: Offline-first PWA with Supabase real-time sync and Tiptap rich editor.
  - PTET Web: Open-source contribution (43 merged PRs) building backend APIs and full-stack features.
